description: Verify this transfer after completed release and retreat. Use one frozen three-camera RGB capture and one Decisions request to judge the destination support/container relationship and whether the target is still held. The operator accepts approximate visual placement; do not require exact post-release XYZ or a visible configured-region marker. Keep target appearance, destination identity and the current transfer location clause separate from CAD retrieval, prior processing, later observation/return and overall completion. No SAM3, FoundationPose, OBB fitting or post-release depth measurement is called. Actual release endpoint, gripper feedback and capture/action bindings are checked independently. After confirmation, update/invalidate the released entity map from execution feedback; this is a predicted transform, not a newly measured pose or full scene rebuild. Reuse unchanged post-release evidence; unknown never causes automatic capture, motion or retry. The graph must explicitly select this skill to obtain visual delivery evidence. execute_place does not invoke it. Returning to an observation posture is a separate graph action, including the operator-required return after each verified delivery. Verification never moves either arm. It never appends global inventory closure, including for the final object; the graph selects verify_task_completion separately.
capability: Verify this completed transfer after release and retreat
